newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians riot in Israeli prison, 13 hurt.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians riot in Israeli prison, 13 hurt.

text.p: Nine Palestinian inmates and four Israeli soldiers were injured in a riot in an army prison on Wednesday, the army said.
An army spokesman said prisoners set tents ablaze while rioting over the extension of detention of Palestinians without trial.
"Inmates of Megiddo prison rioted after it was decided to extend the administrative detention of a number of detainees," the spokesman said.
"Prisoners burned a number of tents ... during the riot nine prisoners and four army soldiers were injured, all from smoke inhalation. The injured were treated in the prison."
The spokesman said military and regular police subdued the riot.
A prisons spokeswoman said there was unrest at a second prison in southern Israel.
She denied the disturbances were related to tensions over Israeli construction of a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
"Security prisoners are banging on cell doors at Nakhsa prison but the situation is under control," she said. She added the two incidents were apparently unrelated.
